newsitem.title: EU: EP RULES OF PROCEDURE COMMITTEE AGENDA - APRIL 14-15.
newsitem.headline: EP RULES OF PROCEDURE COMMITTEE AGENDA - APRIL 14-15.

text.p: Committee on the Rules of Procedure, the Verification of Credentials and Immunities [[ Monday 14 April 1997 ]] 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.068 ) 2.
